title: The Nature of Optical Afterglows without Gamma-Ray Bursts: Identification of AT2023lcr and Multiwavelength Modeling
question: Why were optical afterglows without detected GRBs (AT 2023lcr, AT 2020blt, AT 2021any, AT 2021lfa) not seen with a GRB: off-axis jet, low initial Lorentz factor, or on-axis classical GRB missed by satellites?

what.value: All data for AT 2020blt and AT 2021any

evidence.quote: All data used in this work for AT 2020blt and AT 2021any can be found in (cite: Ho_2020; Ho_2022).

what.value: AT 2021lfa observations (main set) plus additional observations

evidence.quote: To model AT 2021lfa, we used all observations from (cite: Ho_2022) and additional observations from (cite: Lipunov_2022).

what.value: KONUS-Wind 90%-confidence 20-1500 keV peak flux upper limit for AT 2023lcr

evidence.quote: For a typical LGRB spectrum, the 90%-confidence upper limit on the 20–1500 keV peak flux was reported to be $1.8\times10^{-7}\,$erg cm$^{-2}\,$s$^{-1}$ on a 2.944 s scale (cite: Ridnaia2023).

what.value: Gamma-ray energy upper limits for AT 2020blt, AT 2021any and AT 2021lfa

evidence.quote: Limits for AT 2020blt, AT 2021any, and AT 2021lfa have been calculated in (cite: Ho_2020), (cite: Ho_2022), and (cite: Sarin_2022).
To correct for Milky Way extinction we use $A_V=0.128$ mag (cite: Schlafly2011).

what.value: LambdaCDM cosmology used for the luminosity distance

evidence.quote: $\Lambda$CDM cosmology of (cite: Planck_2020) is used throughout.

recipe.goal: Obtain Band 3 flux density and position of AT 2023lcr from ALMA
recipe.method: ALMA data calibrated and imaged with the automated CASA-based pipeline; source detected in both epochs
key_parameters: Band 3 (100 GHz), epochs 2023 June 29 and 2023 July 04

recipe.goal: Fit optical light curve and measure optical spectral index
recipe.method: Multi-band g, r, i, z extinction-corrected light curves fit with a smoothed broken power law with constant magnitude offsets between bands; MCMC fit
key_parameters: smoothness n fixed to 2; t_0 allowed between last GOTO non-detection and first GOTO detection
GOTO L-band point treated as the average of r- and g-band fluxes

recipe.goal: Measure X-ray spectral and temporal indices
recipe.method: Swift/XRT detections fit simultaneously with the online Swift tool; Chandra spectrum fit with sherpa (absorbed power law, 0.5-6 keV); X-ray light curve fit with a single power law at 1 keV
key_parameters: Galactic N_H = 4.12e20 cm^-2; Gamma = 2 adopted for the count-rate to flux conversion
Chandra flux multiplied by 1.77 to go from 0.5-6 keV to 0.3-10 keV

recipe.goal: Derive analytical limits on the jet Lorentz factor
recipe.method: Limits from deceleration time (rise time), radio spectrum (Gamma_avg) and interstellar scintillation size limits, following Perley et al. 2024
key_parameters: t_dec approximated by t_rise; upper limit on t_rise from first detection minus last non-detection
assumptions: typical rest-frame deceleration time of about 200 s; uniform circumburst density; full filling factor

recipe.goal: MCMC afterglow modelling of the radio, optical and X-ray data
recipe.method: afterglowpy jet models (top hat, Gaussian, power law) fit with the emcee EnsembleSampler to radio, optical and X-ray data, for several data subsets and afterglowpy settings
key_parameters: most runs: 64 walkers, 75,000 iterations, 30,000 burn-in; if not converged: 64 walkers, 225,000 iterations, 125,000 burn-in
broad uniform priors (Table of priors, e.g. log10 Gamma_0 in [0,3], theta_c in [0.02,0.78] rad, p in [2,3])
afterglowpy runs repeated with and without ICC and with Gamma_0 infinite and finite
X-ray fluxes converted to a 5 keV flux density with spectral index beta = -1
assumptions: Galactic extinction with R_V = 3.1; redshift z = 1.0272 for AT 2023lcr

recipe.method: reduced chi^2 (minimum over 5,000 posterior samples) and WAIC-based elpd
key_parameters: 5% systematic error on VLA flux densities at 1-18 GHz and 15% at 18-40 GHz

recipe.goal: Compute gamma-ray energy limits and radiative efficiency
recipe.method: KONUS-Wind limits converted to isotropic-equivalent luminosity and energy; eta_gamma = E_gamma,iso / (E_K,iso + E_gamma,iso) using E_K,iso from the model
key_parameters: evaluated at z = 1.0272 and at the redshift upper limit z = 1.6
